selected_evidence.requirement: Create “OS Comparison Root CA” and install it as a trusted system certificate authority
selected_evidence.summary: Shows successful creation and installation; confirms the exact subject, CA:TRUE and signing constraints, system-bundle verification, matching trust anchor, trust registry entry, and mode 600 private key.

Captures healthy pre-restart state with boot ID f1afbc7f-689a-477e-99b4-358a1d1d8226, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID a7f77bf8-8d58-440c-95dc-2d5137f6313b, restored system health, persistent CA files and trust registration, and successful post-restart validation of a CA-signed leaf certificate through the system bundle.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'openssl='; command -v openssl
printf 'trust_tool='; command -v update-ca-trust
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running || true
printf 'existing_anchor='; test -e /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt && echo yes || echo no

set -eu
install -d -m 700 /etc/pki/local-ca/private
install -d -m 755 /etc/pki/local-ca/certs
umask 077
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072 -out /etc/pki/local-ca/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
openssl req -new -x509 -sha256 -days 3650 -key /etc/pki/local-ca/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -out /etc/pki/local-ca/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE' -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' -addext 'authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid:always'
chmod 600 /etc/pki/local-ca/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
chmod 644 /etc/pki/local-ca/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
install -m 644 /etc/pki/local-ca/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
update-ca-trust extract
printf 'created\n'

set -eu
openssl x509 -in /etc/pki/local-ca/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -serial -fingerprint -sha256
openssl x509 -in /etc/pki/local-ca/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -text | grep -A1 'Basic Constraints\|Key Usage'
printf 'verify_bundle='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt /etc/pki/local-ca/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
printf 'anchor_matches='; cmp -s /etc/pki/local-ca/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt && echo yes
printf 'key_mode='; stat -c '%a %U:%G' /etc/pki/local-ca/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
printf 'trust_record='; trust list --filter=ca-anchors | grep -A3 -B1 'OS Comparison Root CA' | head -5
commands.stdout:
subject=CN=OS Comparison Root CA
issuer=CN=OS Comparison Root CA
serial=02E7938A4D59C1B0B8DDEA442382D3DC6668CF3D
sha256 Fingerprint=79:C2:0E:70:77:7B:E8:E5:FB:C3:46:E2:35:38:64:99:68:36:4F:E5:FA:9F:7A:70:38:D4:9C:3E:89:E4:00:F4
            X509v3 Basic Constraints: critical
                CA:TRUE
            X509v3 Key Usage: critical
                Certificate Sign, CRL Sign
verify_bundle=/etc/pki/local-ca/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.crt: OK
anchor_matches=yes
key_mode=600 root:root
trust_record=    type: certificate
    label: OS Comparison Root CA
    trust: anchor
    category: authority

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'pre_restart_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'anchor_file='; test -s /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt && echo present
printf 'bundle_verify='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt /etc/pki/local-ca/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
printf 'trust_anchor='; trust list --filter=ca-anchors | grep -q 'label: OS Comparison Root CA' && echo present

commands.stdout:
Running timer as unit: [REDACTED].timer
Will run service as unit: [REDACTED].service
reboot_scheduled_for_node=node1

commands.command: printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running || true

sleep 5
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running || true

printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running || true

set -eu
printf 'post_restart_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'anchor_file='; test -s /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt && echo present
printf 'private_key='; test -s /etc/pki/local-ca/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key && stat -c 'present mode=%a owner=%U:%G' /etc/pki/local-ca/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
printf 'certificate_subject='; openssl x509 -in /etc/pki/local-ca/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -subject
printf 'bundle_verify='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt /etc/pki/local-ca/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
printf 'trust_record='; trust list --filter=ca-anchors | grep -A3 -B1 'OS Comparison Root CA' | head -5
work_dir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$work_dir"' EXIT
openssl genpkey -quiet -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 -out "$work_dir/leaf.key"
openssl req -new -key "$work_dir/leaf.key" -out "$work_dir/leaf.csr" -subj '/CN=restart-verification.local'
openssl x509 -req -sha256 -days 1 -in "$work_dir/leaf.csr" -CA /etc/pki/local-ca/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -CAkey /etc/pki/local-ca/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -CAcreateserial -CAserial "$work_dir/ca.srl" -out "$work_dir/leaf.crt" >/dev/null 2>&1
printf 'signed_leaf_system_verify='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt "$work_dir/leaf.crt"
commands.stdout:
post_restart_boot_id=a7f77bf8-8d58-440c-95dc-2d5137f6313b
system_state=running
anchor_file=present
private_key=present mode=600 owner=root:root
certificate_subject=subject=CN=OS Comparison Root CA
bundle_verify=/etc/pki/local-ca/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.crt: OK
trust_record=    type: certificate
    label: OS Comparison Root CA
    trust: anchor
    category: authority

signed_leaf_system_verify=/tmp/tmp.FI9lYralTb/leaf.crt: OK
